question: Where can I find a gallery that fall within 60 kilometers in the south direction of Stratton Fire Tower, Stratton, Vermont?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Stratton Fire Tower%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Stratton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%Vermont%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 60000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Stratton Fire Tower%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Stratton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%Vermont%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
